description: Read-only MCP server for Depot (depot.dev): CI failure diagnosis, build forensics, and usage.
name: io.github.akshayjain3450/depot-mcp

environmentVariables.description: Depot Organization token (Organization Settings > API Tokens). Project tokens do not work.
environmentVariables.name: DEPOT_TOKEN

environmentVariables.description: Organization ID, sent as x-depot-org. Required only when the token can see more than one organization.
environmentVariables.name: DEPOT_ORG_ID

environmentVariables.description: Default container-build project so build tools can be called without one.
environmentVariables.name: DEPOT_PROJECT_ID

environmentVariables.description: Cap on log/step pages fetched per tool call.
environmentVariables.name: DEPOT_MCP_MAX_LOG_PAGES

environmentVariables.description: Hard character ceiling on any single tool result.
environmentVariables.name: DEPOT_MCP_OUTPUT_BUDGET

title: Depot (depot.dev)
